_comment: Real section 106 deeds downloaded from Sheffield City Council's public planning register (Idox Public Access). Each entry is the engrossed legal agreement attached to a Sheffield permission granted subject to a planning obligation. Not synthetic.
_tls: the council omits its TLS intermediate, so the issuer was fetched from the certificate's own AIA URL at collection time (repaired-chain.pem)
